Question 5
?

Find and categorize all local the extrema of the function f(x,y)=x2+3y2−4x+4, and determine which of the following statements is true.

a
 f(x,y) has a local maximum at (1,2)
b
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (2,0)
c
 f(x,y) has a saddle point at (2,0)
d
 f(x,y) has a local minimum at (1,2)
e
 f(x,y) has a local maximum at (2,0)
